description: This file defines the Nested class, which is a deprecated formatter class used in the SCSSPHP library. It handles the formatting of nested SCSS code into CSS with specific indentation and block structure.

classes.name: Nested
classes.description: A deprecated formatter class in SCSSPHP for formatting nested SCSS structures.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the formatter with default indentation and formatting settings, and triggers a deprecation warning.

methods.name: indentStr
methods.description: Generates the indentation string based on current depth and indentation level.

methods.name: blockLines
methods.description: Formats the lines within a block, replacing line endings and applying indentation.

methods.name: block
methods.description: Main method that formats a block of SCSS code, managing nested structures, indentation, and block delimiters.

methods.name: hasFlatChild
methods.description: Determines if a given output block has any children without selectors, indicating flatness.
